algorithm: All layer18 non-target columns with loop/reference mean-absolute-activation ratio <=1.1; deterministic cardinality upper bound; if not ruled out, scipy MILP cardinality=4, aggregate Frobenius norm within10%, aggregate loop mean absolute activation within15%, minimize saved per-column log-distance objective with index tie order. No forward outcomes used.
proof: Even the four largest eligible loop activities sum below 85% of target activity, so no 4-column group can meet the activity constraint regardless of weight norms.
